rate_limits.correction: Rate limits are published and endpoint-specific. Current defaults include 2 built-in-provider emails/hour; 30 OTPs/hour; 60-second per-user signup, OTP, and recovery windows; 360 verification requests/hour/IP; 1,800 token refreshes/hour/IP; 15 MFA challenge or verification requests/hour/IP; and 30 anonymous sign-ins/hour/IP. Some limits are configurable, and IP-limited operations allow token-bucket bursts up to 30.

notes: HTTP 0 for the literal YOUR_PROJECT_REF placeholder does not indicate an outage; the current OpenAPI declares the same project-scoped URL. The entry fails because its rate-limit claim and placeholder example are wrong. Free currently includes 50,000 MAU and 5 GB egress. Legacy anon/service_role keys still work, but Supabase recommends publishable/secret keys and plans to deprecate legacy keys by the end of 2026.
